decisions.reason: As a newly launched naval lighting system in a specialized marine segment, it likely has long qualification and sales cycles that favor keeping it on the market.

A spring-balanced desk lamp is more exposed to design and portfolio rationalization than the firm’s core industrial and marine lines, but one year is usually too early for a large firm to withdraw it.
This appears to be a new generation of a core interior-lighting product family, which strongly supports continuation rather than withdrawal.
A pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics fits a standard professional-lighting portfolio, so it is likely retained unless early demand is clearly weak.
Marine HMI searchlights serve a niche but durable B2B market, and the firm would typically keep such a recent specialized launch to build installed-base sales.
A marine searchlight is close to the firm’s specialized maritime offering, making it more likely to be maintained as part of a broader product range.
